id.description: The template reads settings.<id> in theme tokens and sections.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Search and pick one blog category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one blog post. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one brand. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one category. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Toggle. The template reads `true` or `false`.
Search and pick one collection. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Pick and order several collections, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.
Colour picker. The template reads a hex colour.
One of the theme's colour schemes. The template reads the scheme's id.
Image from the media library. The template reads an image URL; use `image_url`.
Menu picker. The template reads the menu from `settings.<id>_resolved`.
Number input. The template reads a number.
A group of the declared `fields`. The template reads an object of field values.
Search and pick one page. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one policy. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Search and pick one product. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Pick and order several products, up to `max`. The template reads a list of the picked items.
Slider. Needs `min` and `max`; `step` and `unit` are optional. The template reads a number.
Rich text editor. The template reads formatted HTML, cleaned of anything unsafe.
Drop-down. Needs `options`. The template reads the chosen option's `value`.
Single-line text. The template reads text.
Multi-line text. The template reads text.
Link. The template reads a URL.
Code editor. The template reads the rendered output of the merchant's Vascula code.
Search and pick one vendor. The template reads the item, or nothing if it was deleted.
Video from the media library. The template reads a video URL.
The theme's colour schemes: a list of schemes with an `id`, `label` and `colors`, described by `fields`.
A font from the platform's font list.
